head: 857cfa9a581ead849d86e0c4ac3bf1d2ec0dbffb
scope: End-to-end completion of the six remaining local-first work areas: expose bounded SCIP ingestion and session recall; implement optional official Google Gemini SDK adapter with deterministic fallback; evaluate and implement reversible local hooks and optional dense retrieval only where evidence supports it; complete documentation and contract hygiene; advance compiler/authority integration without overstating heuristics; and broaden benchmark evidence. Preserve hosted/cloud/full-session non-goals and local deterministic defaults.
non_goals: Hosted tenancy, billing, cloud synchronization, remote overlays, public distribution, enterprise isolation
Full SCM session product and latent development-state runtime
Direct model-driven filesystem writes or ChangeSet bypasses
Changing deterministic local defaults without benchmark evidence
Claiming Tree-sitter/LSP/compiler authority where only lexical or explicit SCIP evidence exists
risks: Official Gemini SDK dependency and API evolution
Filesystem hook mutation and rollback safety
Dense retrieval quality regressions or model identity drift
SCIP ingestion path/root safety and malformed-input handling
Benchmark expansion may reveal quality regressions
Large cross-module change can drift from the declared local-first scope

phases.title: Audit active gaps and current contracts
Implement optional official Gemini SDK adapter
Evaluate reversible hooks and dense retrieval
